protocol_version: pilot (pre-f109cad+1 protocol; evidence tools used default max_samples=200 subsample of 242 train rows)
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Validator only treats direct-child nodes as internal, forcing a split of gate 204 (and its 3 inputs) because it reads out to both the output and gate 290. Nodes 290/1834/1987 take inputs from several annotations so live only in the ischaemia_pathway composition. thal:6 chain 3671->2116 is affine and near-inert (weight -0.013 into 290).

summary: Essentially logistic regression (18 direct edges; logit SD 3.18) plus one small nonlinear ischaemia correction (logit SD 0.78): a ReLU gate on oldpeak, thal:7 and restecg:0 that adds to risk directly and feeds a resting-BP-offset gate read out directly, via a high-threshold amplifier, and via an age term active only without ischaemia evidence. Nonlinear parts add ~+0.010 train AUC (0.932 linear-only vs 0.942).
